_about: Data behind the Part A (historical) charts. Each key names the notebook cell that draws the chart.

dataset.source: EDGAR Community GHG Database (EDGAR_2026_GHG), European Commission JRC

cell4_sector_dashboard.charts: Donut (sector share) + ranked horizontal bar (emissions by sector)

cell5_country_comparison.charts: Faceted bar chart: one panel per sector, countries on x-axis, independent y-axes

cell6_treemap.charts: Treemap Sector -> Country, area & colour = emissions (YlOrRd), text = label + % of parent

cell7_rankings.charts: Bump chart per sector, rank 1 at top, country labels at 2025

cell8_power_change_1990_2025.charts: Diverging horizontal bars sorted by change; red = increase, teal = decrease

cell9_sector_trends.charts: Small multiples: one line + area per sector, 1990–2025

cell10_power_race.charts: Animated horizontal bar race of Power Industry emissions, one frame per year
